testimonials.name: Ila
testimonials.quote: Staying at HammockHostels was honestly one of the warmest hostel experiences I've had. The staff, especially Arjun, was extremely friendly and welcoming. What I loved most was that he treated every guest with the same kindness and patience, making everyone feel comfortable and at home. Being a Malayali myself, I felt even more at ease talking with him 😊 The atmosphere of the hostel was very peaceful and calm, something I didn't expect in a busy place like Bandra. Considering the price and the location, the facilities they provide are truly commendable. I genuinely don't think you can find such a comfortable and well-maintained hostel this easily in areas like Bandra or Khar at this rate. Even though I chose a mixed dorm, I never faced any discomfort. All the hostel mates were decent, pleasant, respectful, and cooperative. I also really liked the common spaces — especially the area near the kitchen where people can chill or smoke, and the little library corner which gave such a cozy vibe 📚 Overall, the place felt very warm and welcoming, and even my cousins enjoyed their stay a lot. Definitely recommended for travellers looking for a peaceful and friendly stay in Mumbai ❤️its safe for solo woman travellers as well.

testimonials.name: Sarah
testimonials.quote: Such a friendly hostel! I was allowed to check in early morning after my night train and also leave my bag and even shower after checking out until my flight departed. Maybe one of the cleanest hostels I've been to in india. There's even a kitchen you can use and they bring you chai at 5pm, good huge common area to hangout as well. Can definitely recommend if you're staying in Mumbai!

testimonials.name: Peter
testimonials.quote: This is really an amazing hostel. They tick all the boxes for backpackers, long stays, nomads etc.. it was plain to see that everyone was happy there, whatever the purpose of their stay. Rooms and facilities were perfect and the general vibe about the place was so welcoming.

testimonials.name: Hatty
testimonials.quote: I don't have enough praise for Hammock Hostel. The location is great - 10 minute walk from the sea front and a range of coffee shops and restaurants in Bandra. The bathrooms and dorms are clean and well stocked at all times and the shared spaces are the right mix of social and chilled. The staff are so helpful - experienced in dealing with hostel-related issues and manage them effectively and fairly. The check in process was quick and simple. Checked in for a few days, stayed for two weeks

testimonials.name: Maurice
testimonials.quote: I wanted to stay for 2 nights and ended up staying for almost two weeks. It's been great. Really felt like a home. The communal area is quite big so you can chill there and always meet people: travelers, locals and people working from there. On my way back, I'll definitely book another night.

testimonials.name: Bibek
testimonials.quote: It was really homely and accommodating and the environment in the hostel is quite good and open. I reached before check-in time early in the morning and they provided me space for waiting till checkin and even provided breakfast. Overall it was a good experience.

testimonials.name: Mortiz
testimonials.quote: One of my best hostel experiences. I spent there two weeks although I only booked 2 days initially. It's great to meet people to actually spend time and explore the city with. The hostel is spotless and the staff super friendly and helpful. I came back to Mumbai and of course checked in here again.

testimonials.name: Hrishikesh
testimonials.quote: I had a fantastic stay at Hammocks Jaipur, a new and beautifully designed hostel in the city. The property is clean, modern, and thoughtfully laid out, with cozy dorms, relaxing common areas, and a great social vibe. One of the biggest plus points was their early check-in, which made my arrival smooth and hassle-free. What truly stood out was the hospitality—the staff was incredibly warm, helpful, and welcoming, always ready with local tips and a smile. The location is convenient yet peaceful, making it easy to explore Jaipur and return to a relaxing space. Highly recommend Hammocks Jaipur for anyone looking for comfort, community, and great service at an affordable price!

testimonials.name: Nick
testimonials.quote: Awesome location and premise. Great hosts and the hostel was very clean and tidy. Highly recommend the local guided tours at the hostel and all the social events. Great to meet fellow travellers and have fun socialising. They also do evening Chai's on the house! Thanks for an amazing hospitality, Hammock! Will be visiting again!recommend it if you are looking for a good place to spend a few days in Jaipur and visit the main attractions - the hostel is located between the city center and the Amber fort.

testimonials.name: Nida
testimonials.quote: I had a wonderful stay at this hostel. The atmosphere was very friendly and welcoming, making it easy to meet other travelers. The rooms and common areas were clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff were extremely helpful and always ready to assist with recommendations and any questions. The location is also very convenient, close to many attractions, cafes, and transport options, which made exploring the city easy. Overall, it's a great place for travelers looking for a comfortable, social, and budget-friendly stay. I would definitely recommend it and would love to stay here again🤍

testimonials.name: Sneha
testimonials.quote: Comfortable stay, aesthetic property, and well-maintained rooms. The staff was very good, polite, and highly cooperative. Overall, a smooth and pleasant experience.
